_comment: Tier-2 for fenics stokes_darcy#2. Tier-2 for fenics stokes_darcy#2: a form that mixes a submesh Function with a parent-mesh measure must be compiled with entity_maps, and in 0.10 that argument is a SEQUENCE of EntityMap objects. Wrong variants: (a) omit entity_maps entirely, (b) pass the older dict form entity_maps={submesh: index_array}. Right variant: entity_maps=[cell_map] with the EntityMap that create_submesh returned. Observed on dolfinx 0.10.0: omitting the argument raises "RuntimeError: Incompatible mesh. argument entity_maps must be provided."; the dict form raises "TypeError: __init__(): incompatible function arguments." whose printed overload list contains "entity_maps: collections.abc.Sequence[dolfinx.cpp.mesh.EntityMap]". With entity_maps=[cell_map] the form compiles and assembles, and so does the rectangular coupling block between a submesh trial function and a parent test function (81 x 45 on this 8x8 mesh). The silent trap reproduces too: integrating the same integrand over the WHOLE parent domain gives exactly the sub-region value, with no warning. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 on dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
expect_in_output: RuntimeError: Incompatible mesh. argument entity_maps must be provided.
